sentences.text:
Syed Sultan, vs The State Of Telangana, on 19 September, 2023
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.22233 of 2023

entities.text: Syed Sultan, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Order:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:-
"...to issue a writ, order or direction especially in the nature of writ of mandamus
declaring the action of respondent No.5 herein in callin

frequently to the Banjara Hills Police Station without any complaint from anybody and without any F.I.R. against the petitioner and harassing the petitioner, is illegal, arbitrary and violative of provisions of the Criminal Procedure Code and violative of Articles 14, 15 and 21 of the Constitution of India..."

2. The case of the petitioner is that on 22.06.2023 a complaint has been filed by one Abdul Khader Jiddawala (respondent No.6) stating that he had paid an amount of Rs.55.00 lakhs to one Mohammed Chand Pasha for executing a sale deed in his favour and instead of executing the sale deed, the said Chand Pasha delayed on one pretext or the other.

Basing on the Court referral complaint a case in Crime No.586 of 2023 was registered on 22.06.2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 471 and CVBR, J Wp_22233_2023 506 of I.P.C. and the name of the petitioner was not shown as accused in the said complaint.

The grievance of the petitioner is that even though his name was not mentioned in the complaint, the respondents-police are frequently summoning him to the police station and confining him for hours together stating that his examination is necessary in the said crime.

3. The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 5, on written instructions, would submit that the investigating officer called the petitioner to the police station only for examining him as one of the witnesses but the petitioner instead of cooperating with the police in investigating into the case has filed the present writ petition with all false and frivolous allegations.
4. As per the written instructions, the petitioner was called to the police station to record his statement as one of the witnesses.

As the name of the petitioner was not mentioned in the crime, the petitioner is directed to cooperate with the investigating agency as witness in the CVBR, J Wp_22233_2023 same crime and the respondents-police are directed not harass the petitioner in any manner and if his presence is required, they shall follow the due procedure of law in recording his statement.
5. With the above observation, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
6. As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
